_source_notes.fouls.bonus_rule: NFHS 2023-24 rule change (scoping doc Sec.4.2): team fouls now reset each quarter, and the bonus is two free throws on the opponent's 5th team foul of the quarter -- the old 7th-foul one-and-one / 10th-foul double-bonus (half-scope) model was eliminated at the NFHS-generic tier. A state that has NOT adopted the current rule (retaining the older half-scope 1-and-1/double-bonus model) would need its own association overlay, not this generic document -- this is the current NFHS baseline, not a placeholder guess.
_source_notes.shot_clock.enabled: false at the NFHS-generic tier. NFHS made a 35-second shot clock a STATE-ADOPTION OPTION starting 2022-23 -- it is not part of the base NFHS rule set, so the generic document defaults it off. A state that has adopted it needs its own association overlay with enabled=true and the chosen length_seconds (30 or 35).
_source_notes.period.format: quarters at the NFHS-generic (varsity) tier -- NFHS varsity basketball is four 8-minute quarters. Sub-varsity/middle-school levels often run shorter quarters or halves instead (scoping doc Sec.4.3); see basketball/us-nfhs-subvarsity.json for that variant.
_source_notes.overtime.length_seconds: 240 (4:00) is the NFHS standard overtime period length -- a plain structural fact, not a placeholder guess, but listed here since it's one of the values the scoping doc's Sec.4.3 asked to double-check.
_source_notes.fouls.personal_foul_disqualification: 5 personal fouls disqualifies a player under NFHS rules -- a plain structural fact (scoping doc Sec.4.3), listed for the same double-check reason as overtime.length_seconds.
_source_notes.technical.shots_awarded: NFHS technical fouls award 2 free throws with the ball returning to play at the division line -- a plain structural fact (scoping doc Sec.4.3), not a placeholder.
_source_notes.timeouts: 3 full + 2 short (60/30-second) per team per game is the commonly-cited NFHS allotment (scoping doc Sec.4.2), but the doc explicitly flags this as needing confirmation -- broadcast/media-timeout formats can vary the exact count. carryover_ot=1 (one timeout carries into overtime) is the typical NFHS convention; media_format is left null pending confirmation of whether a broadcast-timeout format applies.
